title: hooks
responsibility: Puts every request to the owner policy before any page, API, data or media handler runs.

inputs.name: handle.event
inputs.description: The SvelteKit RequestEvent of the incoming request. The hook itself reads only url.pathname, which selects the agent controller, and request, which that controller reads; the owner guard reads only getClientAddress from the event.

inputs.name: handle.resolve
inputs.description: The SvelteKit resolve function, which the hook calls only for an admitted request whose pathname is not /api/agent. Its Response is returned after the hook sets cache-control to 'private, no-store' if the Response has none.

outputs.name: handle
outputs.description: The Response for the request: the guard's 403 'Forbidden' response when the request is denied, otherwise the agent controller's response for /api/agent or resolve's response. A response with no cache-control header gets 'private, no-store' before it is returned.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown by response.headers.set when the response has no cache-control header but immutable headers, such as a response from fetch() or Response.redirect(); nothing in this hook catches it.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown while the module loads when reportBuildIdentity() cannot read the build files (for example a filesystem EACCES error from readdirSync or readFileSync), so the module fails to load.
